newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giordano issues shares to new investors.
newsitem.headline: Giordano issues shares to new investors.

text.p: Giordano International Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to issue a total 40 million new shares at HK$4.90 each to five new shareholders, raising HK$196 million which it intends to use to expand its China operations.

The company said in a statement that it would issue shares to China Haian Enterprise Group Corp, China Haian Enterprise (Beijing) Group Corp, Tianxin Investment & Development Co Ltd, Dalian Sanding Economy Trading Ltd Co and Beijing Haian Aviation Service Co Ltd which are all independent third parties.
The new shares represent about 5.6 percent of Giordano's existing share capital and about 5.3 percent of the enlarged share capital.
"The expansion of the company's shareholder base pursuant to the placing reflects the increasingly diversified geographical base of the group's business," Giordano said.
Giordano shares closed at HK$4.975 on Thursday.
